parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "enterprise access credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as a substitute
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en: The bill batch date in the format of yyyy-MM-dd, such as 2026-06-21
parameters.name: bill_batch

parameters.help_en:
The dimension type. Valid values:

1: bill ID.
2: order number.
3: approval form.
4: invoice title
parameters.help_zh: 1: 账单id 2: 订单号 3: 审批单 4: 发票抬头
parameters.name: dimension

parameters.help_en: The values determined by the dimension parameter. For example, if dimension is set to 1, the values should be bill IDs
parameters.help_zh: 基于dimension决定, 如dimension values 应当传入账单id
parameters.name: values

parameters.help_en:
The customer decision. Valid values:

1: bill in the current period.
2: deferred billing.
null: bill according to the current billing decision of the record
parameters.help_zh: 1: 本期出账 2: 延期出账 null: 按照record当前出账决策进行出账
parameters.name: customer_decision

parameters.help_en: A system parameter. You do not need to manually specify this parameter
parameters.name: app_ip
